name: Operating mechanism
summary: Provides the motive action that operates electrical apparatus.
description: Provides the motive action that operates electrical apparatus.

In a drafting package, connect this reference to the mechanism motor or actuator supply. The associated drawing should trace the operated apparatus, command circuit and position proof; the number identifies the role and does not specify the terminal arrangement, ratings or operating settings.
readingNotes: Identify the mechanism motor or actuator supply.
Trace the operated apparatus, command circuit and position proof.
drawingChecklist: Label the mechanism motor or actuator supply.
Cross-reference the operated apparatus, command circuit and position proof.
Identify the device tag, manual revision and logic drawing that define this implementation.
distinction: The mechanism and the power-switching device are separate drawing functions even when supplied as one assembly.
